title: ai settings / Custom instructions settings
content:
## Custom instructions settings | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(chat.instructionsFilesLocations)`
Additional instruction locations discovered by the editor and forwarded to Agent Host harnesses. Supported, but not recommended for Copilot workflows because other clients do not inherit this setting. Prefer [native harness locations](/docs/agent-customization/migrate-customizations.md#move-customizations-from-configured-locations). | `{ ".github/instructions": true, ".claude/rules": true, "~/.copilot/instructions": true, "~/.claude/rules": true }` | | `setting(chat.includeApplyingInstructions)`
Automatically add instruction files with a matching `applyTo` pattern to Local chat requests. | `true` | | `setting(chat.includeReferencedInstructions)`
Automatically add instruction files referenced via Markdown links to Local chat requests. | `false` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.useInstructionFiles)`
Automatically add custom instructions from `.github/copilot-instructions.md` to Local chat requests. | `true` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGeneration.instructions)` _(Experimental)_
Custom instructions for generating commit messages with AI. | `[]` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescriptionGeneration.instructions)` _(Experimental)_
Custom instructions for generating pull request titles and descriptions with AI. | `[]` | | `setting(github.copilot.chat.organizationInstructions.enabled)`
Control the Local organization instruction provider. See [organization instruction availability](/docs/agents/reference/custom-instructions-reference.md#organization-instructions). | `true` | | `setting(chat.useCustomizationsInParentRepositories)`
Enable discovery of agent customizations (instructions, prompts, agents, skills, hooks) in [parent repository folders](/docs/agent-customization/overview.md#use-customizations-in-a-monorepo) for Local sessions. Useful for monorepo setups where you open a subfolder rather than the repository root. | `false` | | `setting(chat.useHooks)` _(Preview)_
Enable [hooks for the Local harness](/docs/agent-customization/hooks.md#configure-hooks-for-the-local-harness). This setting does not configure Copilot, Claude, or Codex hook execution. | `true` | | `setting(chat.hookFilesLocations)` _(Preview)_
Configure additional Local hook file locations. Specify folders containing `*.json` files or individual `.json` files, using relative or tilde paths. For Copilot, [migrate to a supported hook source](/docs/agent-customization/migrate-customizations.md#find-every-hook-source) instead. | `{}` | | `setting(chat.useClaudeHooks)` _(Preview)_
Enable the Local harness to parse hooks from Claude configuration files. The Local harness ignores Claude matcher values. | `false` | | `setting(chat.useAgentsMdFile)`
Automatically attach instructions from workspace-root `AGENTS.md` files to chat requests in Local harness sessions only. Does not control [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} instruction discovery](/docs/agents/reference/custom-instructions-reference.md#nested-project-instructions) or discovery in other harnesses. | `true` | | `setting(chat.useClaudeMdFile)`
Enable or disable using `CLAUDE.md` files as always-on custom instructions in Local sessions. | `true` | | `setting(chat.useNestedAgentsMdFiles)` `feature(nested-agents-md-files)`
List `AGENTS.md` files in workspace subfolders for on-demand loading in Local harness sessions. Requires `setting(chat.useAgentsMdFile)` to be enabled. Does not affect other harnesses. | `false` |
